description:
Remove OctoPi.TUI.UIBridge as a process. Interactive's existing receive loop already handles {:ui_fire, ...} and {:ui_request, _, _, _} (interactive.ex:651-660). The OctoPi.Coder.Extension.UI module's production functions just send/receive directly to Interactive's pid. ctx.ui = interactive_pid (or nil for headless).

This closes the runtime gap that opi-fin.7 left open and eliminates the per-invocation UIBridge orphan-leak bug.

## Deliverable

UIBridge as a separate process is gone. UI module's functions take a pid and use send/2 + receive directly. Headless mode supported via nil pid (no-op).

## Steps

STEP 1 — Update OctoPi.Coder.Extension.UI module function bodies:
  - notify(pid, msg) when is_pid(pid) → send(pid, {:ui_fire, {:notify, msg}}); :ok
  - notify(nil, _msg) → :ok
  - select(pid, options, kw) when is_pid(pid) → ref = make_ref(); send(pid, {:ui_request, self(), ref, {:select, ref, options, kw}}); receive do {:ui_reply, ^ref, val} -> val end
  - select(nil, _, _) → :cancelled
  - Same shape for confirm/input/editor/get_editor_text/etc.

STEP 2 — Add Runner.bind_ui(runner_pid, ui_pid) call from Interactive on startup; Runner stores it and uses it when constructing ctx.

STEP 3 — Delete apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/ui_bridge.ex.

STEP 4 — Remove all start_ui_bridge / UIBridge references from interactive.ex (lines 50, 126-135, 535, 538, 541, 552, 1149).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] File apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/ui_bridge.ex does NOT exist
- [ ] `grep -rn "UIBridge\|start_ui_bridge" apps/ --include="*.ex" --include="*.exs"` returns 0 matches
- [ ] OctoPi.Coder.Extension.UI module's functions handle nil pid (verify via test)
- [ ] Test: extension on_event/3 calls UI.notify(ctx.ui, "msg") with ctx.ui = interactive_pid → state.notification updates and re-render fires
- [ ] Test: extension calls UI.select(ctx.ui, ["a","b"], []) → pending dialog set in Interactive; when {:ui_reply, ref, val} arrives, the call returns val
- [ ] Test: extension calls UI.notify(nil, "msg") → returns :ok with no side effect (headless mode)
- [ ] When `mix pi` runs with a migrated ping.ex (using UI.notify), "pong!" appears in the notification slot

## Dependencies

Blocked by: opi-fin.13
title: Interactive implements UI directly; delete UIBridge module
